findings.evidence: StaffDetailView returns StaffWorkspaceError for query.isError || !account, including errors with cached account data. StaffAccountTab and its local useStaffAccountForm state are therefore unmounted on a failed background refetch. Retry remounts the editor with staffProfileForm(account), not the unsaved draft. The installed query-core 5.101.2 explicitly exposes isRefetchError = isError && hasData; query error state retains previous data. Providers constructs a default QueryClient, and useStaffDetail does not disable background refetch. The guard only gates explicit navigation/actions and cannot intercept this render branch.
findings.why_it_matters: A Host editing account contact information can lose the draft after a transient network/server error without choosing Save, Cancel, or Discard. Parent editState can additionally remain dirty while the editor/dialog tree is absent. This violates Phase04 dirty-state/discard behavior.
findings.required_action: Distinguish initial/no-data failures from retryable background failures. Preserve the mounted Staff account editor and its draft for retryable refetch errors, expose a safe non-destructive retry notice, and keep guard state accurate. Preserve fail-closed behavior for revoked authorization/not-found rather than continuing to expose an actionable cached profile after 403/404. Do not broaden this fix into the unrelated Student implementation.
findings.change_evidence: StaffDetailView and useStaffAccountForm are new untracked Phase04 output files; the destructive rendering/draft-owner integration is new in this phase.
findings.source_trace: Load account -> open Account/Edit -> modify field -> background detail refetch exhausts retries with transient failure -> query.isError becomes true with prior data -> full-page error replaces/unmounts editor -> successful retry remounts original account draft. Source trace only; no browser execution.

resolution.evidence: Full-page error now applies only to absent data or ApiError status 401/403/404. Other cached-data errors add an inline retry sibling and retain ProfileLayout and the same StaffAccountTab key. Retry does not change editVersion; local draft/guard state remains mounted. No fail-open cached editor after authorization/not-found errors. Re-read during remediation cycle 2; retained fail-closed and stable-editor branches are unchanged.
resolution.conclusion: Original destructive background-error branch is resolved by source inspection. No browser/test proof claimed.

findings.evidence: The form now captures PATCH result in hook-local lastSave and seeds form/baseline from it. However authoritative is local only and not returned to StaffAccountTab/Description; read-only fields still use account[key] from old query data. StaffDetailView increments editVersion on any accepted tab/action and keys StaffAccountTab by publicId-editVersion, resetting lastSave to null on remount. The unchanged API helper still only starts void invalidation; selected query data is not reconciled with the PATCH response. Thus tab navigation loses the bridge while delayed or failed refetch leaves stale account. Object-reference inequality alone also does not establish that a refetch snapshot is newer than the successful PATCH.
findings.why_it_matters: Immediate re-edit within the same hook instance is improved, but successful canonical account data is not owned by a durable selected-account source. Read-only UI can show old saved values, and navigating to another tab and back before refetch completes can seed the next edit with old fields, allowing a full-field PATCH to overwrite the successful change. A transient refetch failure now preserves the mounted profile but still leaves its read-only and remounted editor sources stale.
findings.required_action: Make the successful canonical account the shared, tenant/target-scoped source used by read-only rendering and subsequent edit initialization, surviving editVersion remounts. Reconcile the selected-detail query cache with the PATCH result and protect against older in-flight reads, or retain an ordered authoritative account at a stable feature owner above editor remounts and pass it to both render and form consumers. If relying on refetch instead, keep another edit blocked until an authoritative account is available and explicitly handle refresh failure. Preserve existing invalidation/authorization behavior; do not treat any new object reference as proof of a newer server snapshot.
findings.change_evidence: The Phase03 API helper is unchanged and is supporting evidence, not a reclassified standalone Phase03 finding. The new Phase04 form/read-only consumer and reset/re-edit flow introduce this integration failure.
findings.source_trace: Query account E0 -> PATCH email E1 succeeds -> hook stores result E1 but description still renders E0 -> detail refetch is delayed or fails -> select Overview (no dirty/pending guard now), editVersion increments and editor remounts with lastSave=null -> return Account/Edit before authoritative refetch -> reset uses query E0 -> change phone only -> full-field PATCH sends E0 email, reverting E1. Independent static trace; no test/API/browser execution.
findings.original_gate_evidence: useStaffAccountForm's mutation onSuccess discards ExamStaffAccountResponse and only sets saved=true/editing=false. The existing useUpdateStaffProfile onSuccess fires void invalidateQueries without updating the selected-detail cache or returning the refetch promise. Installed query-core awaits only the hook callback's returned promise before success dispatch. The next Edit calls reset(), which reads staffProfileForm(account) from the still-old detail query. Save always sends all four editable fields, not only the changed field.
findings.original_source_trace: Save email E1 -> PATCH returns canonical E1 -> onSuccess ignores response and starts unawaited detail refetch -> pending ends/Edit appears while account still E0 -> immediately start Edit, change phone only -> reset seeded E0 -> full-field PATCH resubmits E0. A later E1 query update does not resynchronize the already-open draft. Source trace only; no API/browser mutation.

verification.evidence: Canonical account ownership moved to exact tenant/target detail cache; editor-local bridge removed.

verification_history.evidence: Returned canonical result is captured and same-instance reset uses the bridge, but bridge lifetime is shorter than account-view lifetime and read-only fields do not use it.

resolution.evidence: onMutate captures the same tenant/target detail key as useStaffDetail plus current auth generation and awaits exact-key query cancellation. Async onSuccess rejects obsolete auth generations before and after a second cancellation of in-flight detail reads, then setQueryData(context.key, canonical account) precedes existing list/detail/overview/work and tenantUsers invalidation. The installed mutation implementation awaits this hook-level onSuccess before success dispatch and per-call form callbacks. The form now seeds returned canonical fields into form/baseline without an independent account bridge; read-only fields and keyed remounts continue to use the selected detail cache. Existing session generation advances on actor/tenant/role/logout change and provider clears caches. Detail reads pass AbortSignal; exact cancellation prevents older in-flight detail completion from overwriting the result.
resolution.conclusion: The original immediate re-edit and first-cycle tab/remount stale-source paths are resolved by durable query ownership and ordering. Auth-generation protection prevents an old mutation response from repopulating a new protected session's cache. Static source verification only, no API/browser/test execution.
